+"""Product data: users, workspaces, agents, integrations, policies, replay jobs.
+
+Each agent also has its own ops store (`runs/agents/<agent_id>.db`) holding its control plane,
+deploys, observed traces, incidents and actions — tenants never share an ops database.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import re
+import secrets
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import yaml
+
+from ops import security
+from ops.db import OpsDB
+from ops.settings import BACKEND_DIR
+
+PRODUCT_SCHEMA = """
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    login TEXT NOT NULL,
+    name TEXT,
+    avatar_url TEXT,
+    email TEXT,
+    github_token_enc TEXT,
+    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
+    last_seen_at REAL
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspaces (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    name TEXT NOT NULL,
+    owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at REAL NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memberships (
+    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owner',
+    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, workspace_id)
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agents (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    name TEXT NOT NULL,
+    description TEXT,
+    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sdk',        -- sdk | sandbox
+    neatlogs_key_enc TEXT,
+    neatlogs_project_id TEXT,
+    neatlogs_project_name TEXT,
+    workflow_name TEXT,
+    root_span_name TEXT,
+    repo TEXT,                               -- owner/name on GitHub
+    repo_dir TEXT,                           -- local clone used for provenance
+    token_hash TEXT,
+    token_prefix TEXT,
+    economics_json TEXT,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',  -- pending | live | paused
+    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
+    last_seen_at REAL
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integrations (
+    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    kind TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- slack | webhook | ntfy | github
+    config_enc TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
+    created_by TEXT,
+    PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, kind)
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS policies (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    yaml TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
+    created_by TEXT
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replay_jobs (
+    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    incident_id TEXT,
+    inputs_json TEXT NOT NULL,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',  -- pending | claimed | done
+    results_json TEXT,
+    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
+    claimed_at REAL,
+    done_at REAL
+);
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS slack_messages (
+    incident_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    channel TEXT NOT NULL,
+    ts TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+"""
+
+AGENT_DB_DIR = BACKEND_DIR / "runs" / "agents"
+SANDBOX_AGENT_ID = "harbor"
+
+
+def slug(text: str) -> str:
+    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-")
+    return s[:32] or "agent"
+
+
+class ProductStore:
+    def __init__(self, path: Path | str):
+        self.db = OpsDB.__new__(OpsDB)  # reuse OpsDB's locking/helpers with a different schema
+        OpsDB.__init__(self.db, path) if False else None
+        import sqlite3
+        import threading
+
+        self.path = Path(path)
+        if str(path) != ":memory:":
+            self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self.db._lock = threading.RLock()
+        self.db._conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path), check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=None)
+        self.db._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+        self.db._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
+        self.db._conn.executescript(PRODUCT_SCHEMA)
+        self.db.path = self.path
+        self._agent_dbs: dict[str, OpsDB] = {}
+
+    # -- users & workspaces ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def upsert_user(self, user_id: str, login: str, name: str | None, avatar_url: str | None,
+                    email: str | None = None, github_token: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        now = time.time()
+        existing = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", [user_id])
+        if existing:
+            values: dict[str, Any] = {"login": login, "name": name, "avatar_url": avatar_url, "last_seen_at": now}
+            if email:
+                values["email"] = email
+            if github_token:
+                values["github_token_enc"] = security.encrypt(github_token)
+            self.db.update("users", "id", user_id, values)
+        else:
+            self.db.insert("users", {"id": user_id, "login": login, "name": name, "avatar_url": avatar_url,
+                                     "email": email, "github_token_enc": security.encrypt(github_token),
+                                     "created_at": now, "last_seen_at": now})
+        self.ensure_workspace(user_id, login)
+        return self.user(user_id)
+
+    def user(self, user_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT id, login, name, avatar_url, email, created_at, "
+                          "github_token_enc IS NOT NULL AS has_github_token FROM users WHERE id = ?", [user_id]) or {}
+        return row
+
+    def github_token(self, user_id: str) -> str | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT github_token_enc FROM users WHERE id = ?", [user_id])
+        return security.decrypt(row["github_token_enc"]) if row else None
+
+    def ensure_workspace(self, user_id: str, login: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT w.* FROM workspaces w JOIN memberships m ON m.workspace_id = w.id "
+                          "WHERE m.user_id = ? ORDER BY w.created_at LIMIT 1", [user_id])
+        if row:
+            return row
+        wid = f"ws_{secrets.token_hex(6)}"
+        self.db.insert("workspaces", {"id": wid, "name": f"{login}'s workspace", "owner_id": user_id,
+                                      "created_at": time.time()})
+        self.db.insert("memberships", {"user_id": user_id, "workspace_id": wid, "role": "owner"})
+        return self.db.one("SELECT * FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?", [wid]) or {}
+
+    def workspace_for(self, user_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT w.* FROM workspaces w JOIN memberships m ON m.workspace_id = w.id "
+                          "WHERE m.user_id = ? ORDER BY w.created_at LIMIT 1", [user_id])
+        if row is None:
+            u = self.db.one("SELECT login FROM users WHERE id = ?", [user_id])
+            row = self.ensure_workspace(user_id, (u or {}).get("login") or user_id)
+        return row
+
+    def owner_of(self, workspace_id: str) -> str | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT owner_id FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?", [workspace_id])
+        return row["owner_id"] if row else None
+
+    # -- agents ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def create_agent(self, workspace_id: str, name: str, description: str = "", repo: str | None = None,
+                     kind: str = "sdk", agent_id: str | None = None,
+                     economics: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
+        aid = agent_id or f"{slug(name)}-{secrets.token_hex(3)}"
+        token, digest, prefix = security.new_agent_token()
+        self.db.insert("agents", {
+            "id": aid, "workspace_id": workspace_id, "name": name, "description": description, "kind": kind,
+            "repo": repo, "token_hash": digest, "token_prefix": prefix, "status": "pending",
+            "economics_json": json.dumps(economics or default_economics()), "created_at": time.time(),
+        })
+        self.set_policy(aid, DEFAULT_POLICY_YAML, created_by="system")
+        return self.agent(aid) or {}, token
+
+    def rotate_agent_token(self, agent_id: str) -> str:
+        token, digest, prefix = security.new_agent_token()
+        self.db.update("agents", "id", agent_id, {"token_hash": digest, "token_prefix": prefix})
+        return token
+
+    def update_agent(self, agent_id: str, **values: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        if "neatlogs_key" in values:
+            values["neatlogs_key_enc"] = security.encrypt(values.pop("neatlogs_key"))
+        if "economics" in values:
+            values["economics_json"] = json.dumps(values.pop("economics"))
+        if values:
+            self.db.update("agents", "id", agent_id, values)
+        return self.agent(agent_id)
+
+    def agent(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM agents WHERE id = ?", [agent_id])
+        return self._public_agent(row) if row else None
+
+    def agent_secret(self, agent_id: str) -> str | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT neatlogs_key_enc FROM agents WHERE id = ?", [agent_id])
+        return security.decrypt(row["neatlogs_key_enc"]) if row else None
+
+    def agent_by_token(self, token: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM agents WHERE token_hash = ?", [security.hash_token(token)])
+        return self._public_agent(row) if row else None
+
+    def agents_for(self, workspace_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return [self._public_agent(r) for r in
+                self.db.query("SELECT * FROM agents WHERE workspace_id = ? ORDER BY created_at", [workspace_id])]
+
+    def all_agents(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return [self._public_agent(r) for r in self.db.query("SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at")]
+
+    def delete_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> None:
+        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM agents WHERE id = ?", [agent_id])
+        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM policies WHERE agent_id = ?", [agent_id])
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _public_agent(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        out = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in ("neatlogs_key_enc", "token_hash")}
+        out["has_neatlogs_key"] = bool(row.get("neatlogs_key_enc"))
+        out["economics"] = json.loads(row["economics_json"]) if row.get("economics_json") else default_economics()
+        out.pop("economics_json", None)
+        return out
+
+    def agent_db(self, agent_id: str) -> OpsDB:
+        if agent_id not in self._agent_dbs:
+            self._agent_dbs[agent_id] = OpsDB(AGENT_DB_DIR / f"{agent_id}.db")
+        return self._agent_dbs[agent_id]
+
+    # -- policies -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def set_policy(self, agent_id: str, text: str, created_by: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        parsed = yaml.safe_load(text)
+        validate_policy(parsed)
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT MAX(version) v FROM policies WHERE agent_id = ?", [agent_id])
+        version = int((row or {}).get("v") or 0) + 1
+        self.db.insert("policies", {"agent_id": agent_id, "version": version, "yaml": text,
+                                    "created_at": time.time(), "created_by": created_by})
+        return self.policy(agent_id)
+
+    def policy(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM policies WHERE agent_id = ? ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1", [agent_id])
+        if not row:
+            return {"agent_id": agent_id, "version": 0, "yaml": DEFAULT_POLICY_YAML,
+                    "parsed": yaml.safe_load(DEFAULT_POLICY_YAML)}
+        return {**row, "parsed": yaml.safe_load(row["yaml"])}
+
+    def policy_history(self, agent_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return self.db.query("SELECT version, created_at, created_by FROM policies WHERE agent_id = ? "
+                             "ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 20", [agent_id])
+
+    # -- integrations -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def set_integration(self, workspace_id: str, kind: str, config: dict[str, Any], created_by: str | None) -> None:
+        self.db.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO integrations (workspace_id, kind, config_enc, created_at, created_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) "
+            "ON CONFLICT(workspace_id, kind) DO UPDATE SET config_enc=excluded.config_enc, "
+            "created_at=excluded.created_at, created_by=excluded.created_by",
+            [workspace_id, kind, security.encrypt(json.dumps(config)), time.time(), created_by])
+
+    def integration(self, workspace_id: str, kind: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM integrations WHERE workspace_id = ? AND kind = ?", [workspace_id, kind])
+        if not row:
+            return None
+        raw = security.decrypt(row["config_enc"])
+        return json.loads(raw) if raw else None
+
+    def remove_integration(self, workspace_id: str, kind: str) -> None:
+        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM integrations WHERE workspace_id = ? AND kind = ?", [workspace_id, kind])
+
+    def integrations_summary(self, workspace_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        out: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        for row in self.db.query("SELECT kind, created_at FROM integrations WHERE workspace_id = ?", [workspace_id]):
+            cfg = self.integration(workspace_id, row["kind"]) or {}
+            public = {k: v for k, v in cfg.items() if k in ("team_name", "channel", "channel_id", "topic", "url_host",
+                                                            "team_id", "installed_by")}
+            out[row["kind"]] = {"connected": True, "created_at": row["created_at"], **public}
+        return out
+
+    # -- replay jobs (verification hooks run inside the customer's agent via the SDK) -----------------
+    def create_replay_job(self, agent_id: str, incident_id: str | None, inputs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
+        jid = f"rj_{secrets.token_hex(6)}"
+        self.db.insert("replay_jobs", {"id": jid, "agent_id": agent_id, "incident_id": incident_id,
+                                       "inputs_json": json.dumps(inputs), "status": "pending",
+                                       "created_at": time.time()})
+        return jid
+
+    def claim_replay_job(self, agent_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM replay_jobs WHERE agent_id = ? AND status = 'pending' "
+                          "ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1", [agent_id])
+        if not row:
+            return None
+        self.db.update("replay_jobs", "id", row["id"], {"status": "claimed", "claimed_at": time.time()})
+        return {"id": row["id"], "incident_id": row["incident_id"], "inputs": json.loads(row["inputs_json"])}
+
+    def finish_replay_job(self, job_id: str, results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+        self.db.update("replay_jobs", "id", job_id, {"status": "done", "results_json": json.dumps(results),
+                                                     "done_at": time.time()})
+
+    def replay_job(self, job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT * FROM replay_jobs WHERE id = ?", [job_id])
+        if not row:
+            return None
+        return {**row, "inputs": json.loads(row["inputs_json"]),
+                "results": json.loads(row["results_json"]) if row["results_json"] else None}
+
+    # -- slack message refs ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def set_slack_message(self, incident_id: str, channel: str, ts: str) -> None:
+        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO slack_messages (incident_id, channel, ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
+                        [incident_id, channel, ts])
+
+    def slack_message(self, incident_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        return self.db.one("SELECT * FROM slack_messages WHERE incident_id = ?", [incident_id])
+
+
+def default_economics() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """What a bad run costs the customer. Editable per agent; Harbor's comes from the cfo.ai model."""
+    return {"runs_per_hour": {"day": 120, "night": 30},
+            "cost_per_failed_run_usd": 5.0,
+            "human_response_minutes": {"business_hours": 15, "evening": 45, "night": 300},
+            "source": "defaults — edit in the agent's settings or sync from cfo.ai"}
+
+
+DEFAULT_POLICY_YAML = """# What Night Shift may do on its own for this agent.
+gates:
+  min_confidence: 0.6
+  min_projected_loss_usd: 25
+  safety_incident_types: [prompt_injection]
+  max_auto_actions_per_incident: 2
+  verify_replay_min_pass_rate: 0.8
+  auto_undo_if_verify_fails: true
+

+  failover_model:
+    reversible: true
+    allowed_models: [nova-lite, nova-pro, claude-sonnet-4.6]
+  disable_flag:
+    reversible: true
+    allowed_flags: [auto_refund_enabled, tools_enabled]
+  cap_steps:
+    reversible: true
+    min_steps: 4
+
+needs_approval:
+  - deploy_code_fix
+  - revert_commit
+  - refund_customers
+  - contact_customers
+  - delete_data
+"""
+
+KNOWN_AUTO_ACTIONS = {"rollback_release", "failover_model", "disable_flag", "cap_steps"}
+
+
+def validate_policy(p: Any) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(p, dict):
+        raise ValueError("policy must be a mapping")
+    gates = p.get("gates")
+    if not isinstance(gates, dict):
+        raise ValueError("policy needs a 'gates' section")
+    for key in ("min_confidence", "min_projected_loss_usd", "max_auto_actions_per_incident",
+                "verify_replay_min_pass_rate"):
+        if key not in gates:
+            raise ValueError(f"gates.{key} is required")
+    if not 0 <= float(gates["min_confidence"]) <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("gates.min_confidence must be between 0 and 1")
+    auto = p.get("auto") or {}
+    unknown = set(auto) - KNOWN_AUTO_ACTIONS
+    if unknown:
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown auto actions: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
+    for name, rule in auto.items():
+        if not (isinstance(rule, dict) and rule.get("reversible") is True):
+            raise ValueError(f"auto.{name} must be marked reversible: true — irreversible actions need approval")

+"""Agent adapters: how Night Shift sees and steers one agent.
+
+`HarborAdapter` is the built-in sandbox agent (business ledger, local replays).
+`SdkAdapter` is any customer agent that uses the Night Shift SDK: its traces come from the
+customer's neatlogs project, its control plane is read by the SDK, deploys are reported by the
+SDK, and verification replays run inside the customer's agent via SDK replay jobs.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import datetime as dt
+import subprocess
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Callable, Protocol
+
+from harbor import deploy as harbor_deploy
+from harbor import releases as harbor_releases
+from nightshift import provenance
+from nightshift.neatlogs_mcp import NeatlogsMCP
+from ops import llm
+from ops.db import OpsDB
+from ops.economics import load_economics
+from ops.settings import REPO_DIR, settings
+
+
+class Economics(Protocol):
+    def conversations_per_minute(self, at: dt.datetime | None = None) -> float: ...
+    def human_response_minutes(self, at: dt.datetime | None = None) -> float: ...
+    @property
+    def source(self) -> str: ...
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AgentEconomics:
+    raw: dict[str, Any]
+
+    def conversations_per_minute(self, at: dt.datetime | None = None) -> float:
+        hour = (at or dt.datetime.now()).hour
+        per_hour = self.raw.get("runs_per_hour", {}).get("night" if hour < 8 else "day", 60)
+        return float(per_hour) / 60.0
+
+    def human_response_minutes(self, at: dt.datetime | None = None) -> float:
+        hour = (at or dt.datetime.now()).hour
+        r = self.raw.get("human_response_minutes", {})
+        if 9 <= hour < 19:
+            return float(r.get("business_hours", 15))
+        if hour >= 19:
+            return float(r.get("evening", 45))
+        return float(r.get("night", 300))
+
+    @property
+    def cost_per_failed_run(self) -> float:
+        return float(self.raw.get("cost_per_failed_run_usd", 5.0))
+
+    @property
+    def source(self) -> str:
+        return str(self.raw.get("source", "agent settings"))
+
+
+class AgentAdapter:
+    agent_id: str
+    name: str
+    description: str
+    kind: str
+    db: OpsDB
+    mcp: NeatlogsMCP
+    policy: dict[str, Any]
+    economics: Economics
+
+    # control plane -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def active_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def outage_models(self) -> set[str]:
+        return {m.strip() for m in (self.db.get_control("fault:provider_outage") or "").split(",") if m.strip()}
+
+    def deploy(self, release: str, actor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return harbor_deploy.record_deploy(self.db, release, actor=actor, commit_sha=self.release_commit(release))
+
+    def active_release(self) -> str | None:
+        return self.db.get_control("active_release")
+
+    def last_known_good(self, bad_release: str) -> str | None:
+        return harbor_deploy.last_known_good(self.db, bad_release)
+
+    def fallback_model(self) -> str:
+        return settings.harbor_fallback_model
+
+    # provenance ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def release_title(self, release: str) -> str:
+        return release
+
+    def release_commit(self, release: str) -> str | None:
+        row = self.db.one("SELECT commit_sha FROM deploys WHERE release = ? AND commit_sha IS NOT NULL "
+                          "ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1", [release])
+        return row["commit_sha"] if row else None
+
+    def release_diff(self, old: str, new: str) -> str:
+        a, b = self.release_commit(old), self.release_commit(new)
+        if not (a and b and self.repo_dir):
+            return "(no commits recorded for these releases)"
+        out = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--unified=3", a, b], cwd=self.repo_dir, capture_output=True,
+                             text=True, timeout=20)
+        return out.stdout[:6000] or "(no diff)"
+
+    def provenance(self, release: str) -> provenance.Provenance:
+        sha = self.release_commit(release)
+        if not sha or not self.repo_dir:
+            return provenance.Provenance(release=release, file="")
+        return provenance.for_commit(sha, release=release, repo_dir=Path(self.repo_dir))
+
+    repo_dir: str | None = None
+
+    # health & verification --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def check_model_health(self, model: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        started = time.time()
+        try:
+            llm.chat(model, [{"role": "user", "content": "ping"}], max_tokens=1, outage_models=self.outage_models())
+            return {"model": model, "healthy": True, "latency_ms": round((time.time() - started) * 1000)}
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return {"model": model, "healthy": False, "error": str(exc)[:300]}
+
+    def replay(self, conversation_ids: list[str], incident_id: str | None = None) -> Any:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def describe(self) -> str:
+        return f"{self.name}: {self.description}"
+
+
+class HarborAdapter(AgentAdapter):
+    """The built-in sandbox agent: a support agent for a fictional store."""
+
+    kind = "sandbox"
+
+    def __init__(self, db: OpsDB, mcp: NeatlogsMCP | None = None, brain: str | None = None,
+                 policy: dict[str, Any] | None = None, agent_id: str = "harbor"):
+        from nightshift.policy import load_policy
+
+        self.agent_id = agent_id
+        self.name = "Harbor"
+        self.description = ("customer-support agent for Harbor Goods (an outdoor gear store); answers order "
+                            "questions and pays refunds through tools")
+        self.db = db
+        self.mcp = mcp or NeatlogsMCP()
+        self.brain = brain or settings.harbor_brain
+        self.policy = policy or load_policy()
+        self.economics = load_economics()
+        self.repo_dir = str(REPO_DIR)
+
+    def active_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        from harbor.agent import effective_config
+
+        cfg = effective_config(self.db)
+        return {"release": cfg.release.id, "model": cfg.model, "max_steps": cfg.max_steps,
+                "flags": cfg.flags, "tools": cfg.tools}
+
+    def active_release(self) -> str | None:
+        return harbor_deploy.active_release(self.db)
+
+    def deploy(self, release: str, actor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return harbor_deploy.deploy(self.db, release, actor=actor)
+
+    def last_known_good(self, bad_release: str) -> str | None:
+        return harbor_deploy.last_known_good(self.db, bad_release)
+
+    def release_title(self, release: str) -> str:
+        try:
+            return harbor_releases.load_release(release).title
+        except Exception:
+            return release
+
+    def release_commit(self, release: str) -> str | None:
+        return harbor_deploy.release_commit(release)
+
+    def release_diff(self, old: str, new: str) -> str:
+        return provenance.release_diff(old, new)
+
+    def provenance(self, release: str) -> provenance.Provenance:
+        return provenance.for_release(release)
+
+    def check_model_health(self, model: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        if self.brain == "sim":
+            ok = model not in self.outage_models()
+            return {"model": model, "healthy": ok, "probe": "sim", "error": None if ok else "503 Service Unavailable"}
+        return super().check_model_health(model)
+
+    def replay(self, conversation_ids: list[str], incident_id: str | None = None) -> Any:
+        from nightshift import verifier
+
+        return verifier.replay(self.db, conversation_ids, brain=self.brain)
+
+
+class SdkAdapter(AgentAdapter):
+    """A customer agent connected through the SDK and its neatlogs project."""
+
+    kind = "sdk"
+
+    def __init__(self, agent: dict[str, Any], db: OpsDB, mcp: NeatlogsMCP, policy: dict[str, Any],
+                 create_replay_job: Callable[[list[dict[str, Any]], str | None], str] | None = None,
+                 get_replay_job: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any] | None] | None = None):
+        self.agent = agent
+        self.agent_id = agent["id"]
+        self.name = agent["name"]
+        self.description = agent.get("description") or "an LLM agent"
+        self.db = db
+        self.mcp = mcp
+        self.policy = policy
+        self.economics = AgentEconomics(agent.get("economics") or {})
+        self.repo_dir = agent.get("repo_dir")
+        self._create_job = create_replay_job
+        self._get_job = get_replay_job
+
+    def active_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        c = self.db.control_snapshot()
+        return {"release": c.get("active_release"), "model": c.get("force_model") or c.get("default_model"),
+                "max_steps": c.get("max_steps_cap"),
+                "flags": {k[5:]: v.lower() in ("1", "true", "on", "yes") for k, v in c.items() if k.startswith("flag:")}}
+
+    def fallback_model(self) -> str:
+        return self.db.get_control("fallback_model") or settings.harbor_fallback_model
+
+    def replay(self, conversation_ids: list[str], incident_id: str | None = None, timeout_s: float = 90) -> Any:
+        """Ask the agent (through the SDK) to re-run the failing inputs on its current config."""
+        from nightshift.verifier import ReplayResult
+
+        if not conversation_ids or self._create_job is None or self._get_job is None:
+            return ReplayResult(0, 0, 1.0)
+        marks = ",".join("?" for _ in conversation_ids)
+        rows = self.db.query(f"SELECT id, customer_message, outcome FROM conversations WHERE id IN ({marks}) "
+                             f"AND outcome != 'correct' AND customer_message IS NOT NULL AND customer_message != '' "
+                             f"ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 6", conversation_ids)
+        if not rows:
+            return ReplayResult(0, 0, 1.0)
+        inputs = [{"trace_id": r["id"], "input": r["customer_message"], "original_outcome": r["outcome"]} for r in rows]
+        job_id = self._create_job(inputs, incident_id)
+        deadline = time.time() + timeout_s
+        while time.time() < deadline:
+            job = self._get_job(job_id)
+            if job and job.get("status") == "done":
+                items = job.get("results") or []
+                passed = sum(1 for i in items if i.get("ok"))
+                return ReplayResult(len(items), passed, round(passed / len(items), 3) if items else 1.0, items)
+            time.sleep(2)
+        return ReplayResult(len(inputs), 0, 0.0, [{"error": "agent did not run the replay job in time "
+                                                   "(is ns.serve_replays() running?)"}])

"""Signals for SDK agents: traces from the customer's neatlogs project (plus optional outcome
events reported by the SDK), written as rows in the agent's `conversations` table so the same
detector, investigator and verifier work for every agent."""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import logging
import time
from typing import Any

from nightshift.neatlogs_mcp import NeatlogsMCP, NeatlogsMCPError
from ops import llm
from ops.db import OpsDB, dumps

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

NEGATIVE = ("failed", "negative", "escalated")


def _ts(value: str | None) -> float:
    if not value:
        return time.time()
    try:
        return dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp()
    except ValueError:
        return time.time()


def _release_at(db: OpsDB, ts: float) -> str:
    row = db.one("SELECT release FROM deploys WHERE ts <= ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1", [ts])
    return row["release"] if row else (db.get_control("active_release") or "unknown")


def _event_for(db: OpsDB, trace_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return db.one("SELECT * FROM events WHERE trace_id = ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1", [trace_id])


def row_from_trace(db: OpsDB, t: dict[str, Any], cost_per_failed_run: float, price_model: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ts = _ts(t.get("start_ts") or t.get("created_at"))
    errored = int(t.get("errored_span_count") or 0)
    failed = (t.get("status") or "success") != "success"
    tokens = int(t.get("total_tokens") or 0)
    ev = _event_for(db, t["trace_id"])
    outcome = "failed" if failed else ("tool_error" if errored else "correct")
    loss = cost_per_failed_run if failed else 0.0
    model = ""
    if ev:
        model = ev.get("model") or ""
        if ev["outcome"] in NEGATIVE:
            outcome = "escalated" if ev["outcome"] == "escalated" else "failed"
            loss = max(loss, float(ev.get("value_usd") or 0) or cost_per_failed_run)
        elif ev["outcome"] == "ok" and not failed:
            outcome = "correct"

"""Night Shift SDK: read the control plane Night Shift steers, report deploys and outcomes, and run
verification replays. Zero dependencies; fail-open by design."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

__all__ = ["NightShift", "current_trace_id"]
__version__ = "0.1.0"

log = logging.getLogger("nightshift_sdk")


def current_trace_id() -> Optional[str]:
    """The active OpenTelemetry/neatlogs trace id, if tracing is on (else None)."""
    try:
        from opentelemetry import trace  # type: ignore

        ctx = trace.get_current_span().get_span_context()
        return format(ctx.trace_id, "032x") if ctx and ctx.trace_id else None
    except Exception:
        return None


class NightShift:
    def __init__(self, api_url: Optional[str] = None, token: Optional[str] = None, refresh_s: float = 5.0,
                 timeout_s: float = 4.0):
        self.api_url = (api_url or os.environ.get("NIGHTSHIFT_API_URL", "")).rstrip("/")
        self.token = token or os.environ.get("NIGHTSHIFT_AGENT_TOKEN", "")
        self.refresh_s = refresh_s
        self.timeout_s = timeout_s
        self._config: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._fetched_at = 0.0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._replay_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self._stop = threading.Event()

    # -- transport --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.api_url and self.token)

    def _request(self, method: str, path: str, body: Optional[dict] = None) -> Any:
        data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(f"{self.api_url}{path}", data=data, method=method, headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}", "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "User-Agent": f"nightshift-sdk/{__version__}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout_s) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
            return json.loads(raw) if raw else None

    # -- control plane ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def config(self, force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not self.enabled:
            return {}
        with self._lock:
            if not force and time.time() - self._fetched_at < self.refresh_s:
                return self._config
            try:
                self._config = self._request("GET", "/v1/control") or {}
            except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
                log.debug("night shift unreachable, using last known config: %s", exc)
            self._fetched_at = time.time()
            return self._config

    def release(self, default: str) -> str:
        return self.config().get("active_release") or default

    def model(self, default: str) -> str:
        c = self.config()
        return c.get("force_model") or default

    def flag(self, name: str, default: bool = True) -> bool:
        value = self.config().get(f"flag:{name}")
        if value is None:
            return default
        return str(value).lower() in ("1", "true", "on", "yes")

    def max_steps(self, default: int) -> int:
        cap = self.config().get("max_steps_cap")
        return min(default, int(cap)) if cap else default

    # -- reporting ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def report_deploy(self, release: str, commit: Optional[str] = None, actor: str = "ci",
                      default_model: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        return self._post("/v1/deploys", {"release": release, "commit": commit, "actor": actor,
                                           "default_model": default_model})

    def record(self, outcome: str, trace_id: Optional[str] = None, value_usd: float = 0.0,
               release: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, note: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        """outcome: ok | failed | escalated | negative. value_usd: money lost on this run, if any."""
        return self._post("/v1/events", {"outcome": outcome, "trace_id": trace_id or current_trace_id(),
                                          "value_usd": value_usd, "release": release, "model": model,
                                          "note": note})

    def _post(self, path: str, body: dict) -> bool:
        if not self.enabled:
            return False
        try:
            self._request("POST", path, body)
            return True
        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            log.debug("night shift post %s failed: %s", path, exc)
            return False

    # -- verification hook ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def serve_replays(self, handler: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]], poll_s: float = 3.0) -> None:
        """Run Night Shift's replay jobs through your agent in a background thread.

        handler(input_text) must run the agent on the current config without side effects and return
        {"ok": bool, "output": str, "trace_id": optional str}.
        """
        if not self.enabled or self._replay_thread:
            return

        def loop() -> None:
            while not self._stop.is_set():
                try:
                    job = self._request("GET", "/v1/replays/next")
                except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):
                    job = None
                if job and job.get("id"):
                    results = []
                    for item in job.get("inputs", []):
                        try:
                            self.config(force=True)
                            r = handler(item["input"]) or {}
                            results.append({"trace_id": item.get("trace_id"), "ok": bool(r.get("ok")),
                                            "output": str(r.get("output", ""))[:500],
                                            "replay_trace": r.get("trace_id")})
                        except Exception as exc:  # a crash is a failed replay, not a crash of the agent
                            results.append({"trace_id": item.get("trace_id"), "ok": False, "error": str(exc)[:300]})
                    self._post(f"/v1/replays/{job['id']}/results", {"results": results})
                    continue
                self._stop.wait(poll_s)

        self._replay_thread = threading.Thread(target=loop, name="nightshift-replays", daemon=True)
        self._replay_thread.start()

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()

        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout_s) as resp:

    def config(self, force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:

            return {}

            if not force and time.time() - self._fetched_at < self.refresh_s:
                return self._config
            try:

            except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
                log.debug("night shift unreachable, using last known config: %s", exc)

        return self.config().get("active_release") or default

        c = self.config()
        return c.get("force_model") or default

        value = self.config().get(f"flag:{name}")

        cap = self.config().get("max_steps_cap")

                                          "note": note})

            return False

    def serve_replays(self, handler: Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]], poll_s: float = 3.0) -> None:
        """Run Night Shift's replay jobs through your agent in a background thread.

        handler(input_text) must run the agent on the current config without side effects and return
        {"ok": bool, "output": str, "trace_id": optional str}.
        """
        if not self.enabled or self._replay_thread:
            return

        def loop() -> None:
            while not self._stop.is_set():
                try:
                    job = self._request("GET", "/v1/replays/next")
                except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):
                    job = None
                if job and job.get("id"):
                    results = []
                    for item in job.get("inputs", []):
                        try:
                            self.config(force=True)
                            r = handler(item["input"]) or {}
                            results.append({"trace_id": item.get("trace_id"), "ok": bool(r.get("ok")),
                                            "output": str(r.get("output", ""))[:500],
                                            "replay_trace": r.get("trace_id")})
                        except Exception as exc:  # a crash is a failed replay, not a crash of the agent
                            results.append({"trace_id": item.get("trace_id"), "ok": False, "error": str(exc)[:300]})
                    self._post(f"/v1/replays/{job['id']}/results", {"results": results})
                    continue
                self._stop.wait(poll_s)

        self._replay_thread = threading.Thread(target=loop, name="nightshift-replays", daemon=True)
        self._replay_thread.start()

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()

human approves it.

The PR reverts the culprit commit's changes file by file (contents restored from its parent), adds
the regression eval Night Shift generated from the failing traces, and carries the postmortem.
Uses the approving user's GitHub token from sign-in.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import logging
import time
from typing import Any

import httpx

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
API = "https://api.github.com"


class GitHubError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _client(token: str) -> httpx.Client:
    return httpx.Client(base_url=API, timeout=30, headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28", "User-Agent": "night-shift"})


def _check(r: httpx.Response) -> Any:
    if r.status_code >= 400:
        raise GitHubError(f"GitHub {r.request.method} {r.request.url.path}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}")
    return r.json() if r.content else None


def open_revert_pr(token: str, repo: str, commit_sha: str, incident_id: str, title: str, body: str,
                   extra_files: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with _client(token) as gh:
        info = _check(gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}"))
        base_branch = info["default_branch"]
        base_sha = _check(gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/git/ref/heads/{base_branch}"))["object"]["sha"]
        commit = _check(gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/commits/{commit_sha}"))
        parent = commit["parents"][0]["sha"] if commit.get("parents") else None
        branch = f"nightshift/fix-{incident_id.lower()}-{int(time.time()) % 100000}"
        _check(gh.post(f"/repos/{repo}/git/refs", json={"ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}", "sha": base_sha}))

        for f in commit.get("files", []):
            path = f["filename"]
            current = gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", params={"ref": branch})
            current_sha = current.json().get("sha") if current.status_code == 200 else None
            if f["status"] == "added":
                if current_sha:
                    _check(gh.request("DELETE", f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", json={
                        "message": f"Revert {path} (introduced by {commit_sha[:8]})", "sha": current_sha,
                        "branch": branch}))
                continue
            old = gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", params={"ref": parent})
            if old.status_code != 200:
                continue
            payload = {"message": f"Restore {path} from before {commit_sha[:8]}", "content": old.json()["content"]
                       .replace("\n", ""), "branch": branch}
            if current_sha:
                payload["sha"] = current_sha
            _check(gh.put(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", json=payload))

        for path, text in (extra_files or {}).items():
            _check(gh.put(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", json={
                "message": f"Add {path} from {incident_id}", "branch": branch,
                "content": base64.b64encode(text.encode()).decode()}))

        pr = _check(gh.post(f"/repos/{repo}/pulls", json={"title": title, "head": branch, "base": base_branch,
                                                         "body": body, "draft": False}))
        return {"url": pr["html_url"], "number": pr["number"], "branch": branch}

+    pass
+
+
+def _client(token: str) -> httpx.Client:
+    return httpx.Client(base_url=API, timeout=30, headers={
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
+        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28", "User-Agent": "night-shift"})
+
+
+def _check(r: httpx.Response) -> Any:
+    if r.status_code >= 400:
+        raise GitHubError(f"GitHub {r.request.method} {r.request.url.path}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}")
+    return r.json() if r.content else None
+
+
+def open_revert_pr(token: str, repo: str, commit_sha: str, incident_id: str, title: str, body: str,
+                   extra_files: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    with _client(token) as gh:
+        info = _check(gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}"))
+        base_branch = info["default_branch"]
+        base_sha = _check(gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/git/ref/heads/{base_branch}"))["object"]["sha"]
+        commit = _check(gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/commits/{commit_sha}"))
+        parent = commit["parents"][0]["sha"] if commit.get("parents") else None
+        branch = f"nightshift/fix-{incident_id.lower()}-{int(time.time()) % 100000}"
+        _check(gh.post(f"/repos/{repo}/git/refs", json={"ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}", "sha": base_sha}))
+
+        for f in commit.get("files", []):
+            path = f["filename"]
+            current = gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", params={"ref": branch})
+            current_sha = current.json().get("sha") if current.status_code == 200 else None
+            if f["status"] == "added":
+                if current_sha:
+                    _check(gh.request("DELETE", f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", json={
+                        "message": f"Revert {path} (introduced by {commit_sha[:8]})", "sha": current_sha,
+                        "branch": branch}))
+                continue
+            old = gh.get(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", params={"ref": parent})
+            if old.status_code != 200:
+                continue
+            payload = {"message": f"Restore {path} from before {commit_sha[:8]}", "content": old.json()["content"]
+                       .replace("\n", ""), "branch": branch}
+            if current_sha:
+                payload["sha"] = current_sha
+            _check(gh.put(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", json=payload))
+
+        for path, text in (extra_files or {}).items():
+            _check(gh.put(f"/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}", json={
+                "message": f"Add {path} from {incident_id}", "branch": branch,
+                "content": base64.b64encode(text.encode()).decode()}))
+
+        pr = _check(gh.post(f"/repos/{repo}/pulls", json={"title": title, "head": branch, "base": base_branch,
+                                                         "body": body, "draft": False}))
+        return {"url": pr["html_url"], "number": pr["number"], "branch": branch}

"""Workspace paging: Slack (with buttons), a generic webhook, and ntfy — whichever are connected."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
from typing import Any

import httpx

from nightshift import notifier
from product import slack
from product.store import ProductStore

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def web_url(path: str) -> str:
    return os.environ.get("PUBLIC_WEB_URL", os.environ.get("PUBLIC_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:3000")).rstrip("/") + path


def incident_buttons(adapter: Any, incident_id: str) -> tuple[int | None, int | None, str]:
    db = adapter.db
    proposal = db.one("SELECT id FROM actions WHERE incident_id = ? AND status = 'proposed' "
                      "ORDER BY (kind = 'deploy_code_fix') DESC, ts DESC LIMIT 1", [incident_id])
    applied = db.one("SELECT id FROM actions WHERE incident_id = ? AND status = 'applied' AND mode = 'auto' "
                     "ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1", [incident_id])
    inc = db.one("SELECT status FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", [incident_id]) or {}
    return (proposal or {}).get("id"), (applied or {}).get("id"), inc.get("status", "OPEN")


def make_pager(store: ProductStore, workspace_id: str, agent: dict[str, Any]):
    def pager(adapter: Any, incident_id: str, page: notifier.Page) -> dict[str, Any]:
        delivered: list[str] = []
        errors: list[str] = []
        url = web_url(f"/app/incidents/{agent['id']}/{incident_id}")
        cfg = store.integration(workspace_id, "slack")
        if cfg:
            try:
                proposal_id, undo_id, status = incident_buttons(adapter, incident_id)
                blocks = slack.incident_blocks(page.title, page.body, agent["name"], incident_id, agent["id"], url,
                                               proposal_id, undo_id, status)
                existing = store.slack_message(incident_id)
                ref = slack.post_or_update(cfg, blocks, f"{page.title} — {page.body}", None)
                if ref:
                    store.set_slack_message(incident_id, ref["channel"], ref["ts"])
                    delivered.append(f"slack #{cfg.get('channel', '').lstrip('#')}")
                del existing
            except Exception as exc:  # paging must never break the incident flow
                errors.append(f"slack: {exc}")
        hook = store.integration(workspace_id, "webhook")
        if hook and hook.get("url"):
            try:
                httpx.post(hook["url"], json={"title": page.title, "body": page.body, "priority": page.priority,
                                              "incident_id": incident_id, "agent_id": agent["id"], "url": url},
                           timeout=10).raise_for_status()
                delivered.append("webhook")
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f"webhook: {exc}")
        ntfy = store.integration(workspace_id, "ntfy")
        if ntfy and ntfy.get("topic"):
            try:
                httpx.post(f"https://ntfy.sh/{ntfy['topic']}", content=page.body.encode(),
                           headers={"Title": page.title.encode("utf-8").decode("latin-1", "ignore"),
                                    "Priority": page.priority, "Click": url, "Tags": "crescent_moon"},
                           timeout=10).raise_for_status()
                delivered.append("ntfy")
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f"ntfy: {exc}")
        return {"delivered": delivered or ["console"], "errors": errors, "title": page.title, "body": page.body,
                "click_url": url}

    return pager

"""The multi-tenant runtime: every connected agent gets its own ops store, Night Shift instance and
neatlogs poller; the Harbor sandbox runs alongside as a shared demo agent."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
import time
from typing import Any

from api.runtime import EventBus, Runtime
from nightshift import actions as ns_actions
from nightshift import reporter, sources
from nightshift.adapters import SdkAdapter
from nightshift.neatlogs_mcp import NeatlogsMCP
from nightshift.runner import NightShift, approve
from ops.db import loads
from ops.settings import BACKEND_DIR
from product import github_fix, slack
from product.paging import make_pager
from product.store import ProductStore

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

POLL_EVERY_S = 15
TICK_EVERY_S = 5


class Platform:
    def __init__(self, product_db: str | None = None):
        self.store = ProductStore(product_db or BACKEND_DIR / "runs" / "product.db")
        self.sandbox = Runtime()
        self.bus: EventBus = self.sandbox.bus
        self._ns: dict[str, NightShift] = {}
        self._mcp: dict[str, NeatlogsMCP] = {}
        self._last_poll: dict[str, float] = {}
        self._stop = threading.Event()
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    # -- lifecycle -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def start(self) -> None:
        self.sandbox.start()
        self._stop.clear()
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._loop, name="fleet", daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()
        self.sandbox.stop()

    def _loop(self) -> None:
        while not self._stop.wait(TICK_EVERY_S):
            for agent in self.store.all_agents():
                if agent["kind"] != "sdk" or agent["status"] != "live":
                    continue
                try:
                    self.tick_agent(agent)
                except Exception as exc:  # one tenant's failure never stops the fleet
                    log.exception("agent %s tick failed: %s", agent["id"], exc)

    # -- per agent -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def mcp_for(self, agent_id: str) -> NeatlogsMCP:
        key = self.store.agent_secret(agent_id) or ""
        cached = self._mcp.get(agent_id)
        if cached is None or cached.api_key != key:
            cached = NeatlogsMCP(api_key=key)
            self._mcp[agent_id] = cached
        return cached

    def adapter_for(self, agent: dict[str, Any]) -> SdkAdapter:
        db = self.store.agent_db(agent["id"])
        return SdkAdapter(agent, db, self.mcp_for(agent["id"]), self.store.policy(agent["id"])["parsed"],
                          create_replay_job=lambda inputs, iid, aid=agent["id"]: self.store.create_replay_job(aid, iid, inputs),
                          get_replay_job=self.store.replay_job)

    def nightshift_for(self, agent: dict[str, Any]) -> NightShift:
        with self._lock:
            ns = self._ns.get(agent["id"])
            adapter = self.adapter_for(agent)
            if ns is None:
                ns = NightShift(adapter.db, mcp=adapter.mcp, brain="live", adapter=adapter,
                                on_event=lambda e, a=agent: self.publish(a, e),
                                pager=make_pager(self.store, agent["workspace_id"], agent))
                self._ns[agent["id"]] = ns
            else:  # pick up policy / economics / key edits
                ns.adapter = adapter
                ns.mcp = adapter.mcp
            return ns

    def tick_agent(self, agent: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        db = self.store.agent_db(agent["id"])
        if time.time() - self._last_poll.get(agent["id"], 0) >= POLL_EVERY_S:
            self._last_poll[agent["id"]] = time.time()
            new = sources.poll_neatlogs(db, self.mcp_for(agent["id"]), agent)
            if new:
                self.publish(agent, {"type": "traces", "new": new})
        self.nightshift_for(agent).tick()

    def publish(self, agent: dict[str, Any], event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.bus.publish({**event, "workspace_id": agent["workspace_id"], "agent_id": agent["id"]})

    # -- human decisions -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def approve(self, agent: dict[str, Any], action_id: int, user_id: str, actor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        adapter = self.adapter_for(agent)
        row = adapter.db.one("SELECT * FROM actions WHERE id = ?", [action_id])
        if row is None or row["status"] != "proposed":
            return {"error": "not a pending proposal"}
        params = loads(row["params_json"], {})
        result: dict[str, Any]
        if row["kind"] == "deploy_code_fix" and params.get("revert_commit") and agent.get("repo"):
            token = self.store.github_token(user_id) or self.store.github_token(
                self.store.owner_of(agent["workspace_id"]) or "")
            if not token:
                return {"error": "connect GitHub (sign in with GitHub) to open the fix PR"}
            body = reporter.postmortem(adapter.db, row["incident_id"])
            extra: dict[str, str] = {}
            reg = reporter.REGRESSION_DIR / f"{row['incident_id']}.yaml"
            if reg.exists():
                extra[f"nightshift/regressions/{reg.name}"] = reg.read_text()
            try:
                pr = github_fix.open_revert_pr(token, agent["repo"], params["revert_commit"], row["incident_id"],
                                               f"Night Shift fix for {row['incident_id']}: revert {params['revert_commit'][:8]}",
                                               body + "\n\n_Opened by Night Shift after approval by " + actor + "._",
                                               extra)
            except github_fix.GitHubError as exc:
                return {"error": str(exc)}
            adapter.db.update("actions", "id", action_id, {"status": "approved", "reason": f"PR {pr['url']}"})
            result = {"status": "pr_opened", "pr": pr}
        else:
            result = approve(adapter, action_id, actor=actor)
        adapter.db.insert("incident_events", {"incident_id": row["incident_id"], "ts": time.time(), "kind": "approve",
                                              "title": f"{actor} approved {row['kind']}"
                                                       + (f" → {result['pr']['url']}" if result.get("pr") else ""),
                                              "detail_json": None})
        self.publish(agent, {"type": "incident_update", "incident_id": row["incident_id"]})
        self._refresh_slack(agent, row["incident_id"], f"✅ {actor} approved {row['kind'].replace('_', ' ')}"
                            + (f": {result['pr']['url']}" if result.get("pr") else ""))
        return result

    def undo(self, agent: dict[str, Any], action_id: int, actor: str) -> str:
        adapter = self.adapter_for(agent)
        row = adapter.db.one("SELECT incident_id FROM actions WHERE id = ?", [action_id]) or {}
        note = ns_actions.undo(adapter, action_id)
        if row:
            adapter.db.insert("incident_events", {"incident_id": row["incident_id"], "ts": time.time(), "kind": "undo",
                                                  "title": f"{actor}: {note}", "detail_json": None})
            self._refresh_slack(agent, row["incident_id"], f"↩️ {actor}: {note}")
            self.publish(agent, {"type": "incident_update", "incident_id": row["incident_id"]})
        return note

    def _refresh_slack(self, agent: dict[str, Any], incident_id: str, note: str) -> None:
        cfg = self.store.integration(agent["workspace_id"], "slack")
        ref = self.store.slack_message(incident_id)
        if cfg and ref:
            slack.post_thread_note(cfg, ref, note)

+        while not self._stop.wait(TICK_EVERY_S):
+            for agent in self.store.all_agents():
+                if agent["kind"] != "sdk" or agent["status"] != "live":
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    self.tick_agent(agent)
+                except Exception as exc:  # one tenant's failure never stops the fleet
+                    log.exception("agent %s tick failed: %s", agent["id"], exc)
+
+    # -- per agent -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def mcp_for(self, agent_id: str) -> NeatlogsMCP:
+        key = self.store.agent_secret(agent_id) or ""
+        cached = self._mcp.get(agent_id)
+        if cached is None or cached.api_key != key:
+            cached = NeatlogsMCP(api_key=key)
+            self._mcp[agent_id] = cached
+        return cached
+
+    def adapter_for(self, agent: dict[str, Any]) -> SdkAdapter:
+        db = self.store.agent_db(agent["id"])
+        return SdkAdapter(agent, db, self.mcp_for(agent["id"]), self.store.policy(agent["id"])["parsed"],
+                          create_replay_job=lambda inputs, iid, aid=agent["id"]: self.store.create_replay_job(aid, iid, inputs),
+                          get_replay_job=self.store.replay_job)
+
+    def nightshift_for(self, agent: dict[str, Any]) -> NightShift:
+        with self._lock:
+            ns = self._ns.get(agent["id"])
+            adapter = self.adapter_for(agent)
+            if ns is None:
+                ns = NightShift(adapter.db, mcp=adapter.mcp, brain="live", adapter=adapter,
+                                on_event=lambda e, a=agent: self.publish(a, e),
+                                pager=make_pager(self.store, agent["workspace_id"], agent))
+                self._ns[agent["id"]] = ns
+            else:  # pick up policy / economics / key edits
+                ns.adapter = adapter
+                ns.mcp = adapter.mcp
+            return ns
+
+    def tick_agent(self, agent: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        db = self.store.agent_db(agent["id"])
+        if time.time() - self._last_poll.get(agent["id"], 0) >= POLL_EVERY_S:
+            self._last_poll[agent["id"]] = time.time()
+            new = sources.poll_neatlogs(db, self.mcp_for(agent["id"]), agent)
+            if new:
+                self.publish(agent, {"type": "traces", "new": new})
+        self.nightshift_for(agent).tick()
+
+    def publish(self, agent: dict[str, Any], event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        self.bus.publish({**event, "workspace_id": agent["workspace_id"], "agent_id": agent["id"]})
+
+    # -- human decisions -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def approve(self, agent: dict[str, Any], action_id: int, user_id: str, actor: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        adapter = self.adapter_for(agent)
+        row = adapter.db.one("SELECT * FROM actions WHERE id = ?", [action_id])
+        if row is None or row["status"] != "proposed":
+            return {"error": "not a pending proposal"}
+        params = loads(row["params_json"], {})
+        result: dict[str, Any]
+        if row["kind"] == "deploy_code_fix" and params.get("revert_commit") and agent.get("repo"):
+            token = self.store.github_token(user_id) or self.store.github_token(
+                self.store.owner_of(agent["workspace_id"]) or "")
+            if not token:
+                return {"error": "connect GitHub (sign in with GitHub) to open the fix PR"}
+            body = reporter.postmortem(adapter.db, row["incident_id"])
+            extra: dict[str, str] = {}
+            reg = reporter.REGRESSION_DIR / f"{row['incident_id']}.yaml"
+            if reg.exists():
+                extra[f"nightshift/regressions/{reg.name}"] = reg.read_text()
+            try:
+                pr = github_fix.open_revert_pr(token, agent["repo"], params["revert_commit"], row["incident_id"],
+                                               f"Night Shift fix for {row['incident_id']}: revert {params['revert_commit'][:8]}",
+                                               body + "\n\n_Opened by Night Shift after approval by " + actor + "._",
+                                               extra)
+            except github_fix.GitHubError as exc:
+                return {"error": str(exc)}
+            adapter.db.update("actions", "id", action_id, {"status": "approved", "reason": f"PR {pr['url']}"})
+            result = {"status": "pr_opened", "pr": pr}
+        else:
+            result = approve(adapter, action_id, actor=actor)
+        adapter.db.insert("incident_events", {"incident_id": row["incident_id"], "ts": time.time(), "kind": "approve",
+                                              "title": f"{actor} approved {row['kind']}"
+                                                       + (f" → {result['pr']['url']}" if result.get("pr") else ""),
+                                              "detail_json": None})
+        self.publish(agent, {"type": "incident_update", "incident_id": row["incident_id"]})
+        self._refresh_slack(agent, row["incident_id"], f"✅ {actor} approved {row['kind'].replace('_', ' ')}"
+                            + (f": {result['pr']['url']}" if result.get("pr") else ""))
+        return result
+
+    def undo(self, agent: dict[str, Any], action_id: int, actor: str) -> str:
+        adapter = self.adapter_for(agent)
+        row = adapter.db.one("SELECT incident_id FROM actions WHERE id = ?", [action_id]) or {}
+        note = ns_actions.undo(adapter, action_id)
+        if row:
+            adapter.db.insert("incident_events", {"incident_id": row["incident_id"], "ts": time.time(), "kind": "undo",
+                                                  "title": f"{actor}: {note}", "detail_json": None})
+            self._refresh_slack(agent, row["incident_id"], f"↩️ {actor}: {note}")
+            self.publish(agent, {"type": "incident_update", "incident_id": row["incident_id"]})
+        return note
+
+    def _refresh_slack(self, agent: dict[str, Any], incident_id: str, note: str) -> None:
+        cfg = self.store.integration(agent["workspace_id"], "slack")
+        ref = self.store.slack_message(incident_id)
+        if cfg and ref:
+            slack.post_thread_note(cfg, ref, note)

"""Local clones of connected repositories, including Entire checkpoint refs, for provenance."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from ops.settings import BACKEND_DIR

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
REPOS_DIR = BACKEND_DIR / "runs" / "repos"
REPO_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")


def _url(repo: str, token: str | None) -> str:
    return f"REDACTED" if token else f"https://github.com/{repo}.git"


def _run(args: list[str], cwd: Path | None = None, timeout: int = 180) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)


def ensure_clone(repo: str, token: str | None = None) -> Path:
    if not REPO_RE.match(repo):
        raise ValueError("repo must look like owner/name")
    path = REPOS_DIR / repo.replace("/", "__")
    if not (path / ".git").exists():
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out = _run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--filter=blob:none", _url(repo, token), str(path)])
        if out.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"clone failed: {out.stderr.strip()[:300].replace(token or '§', '***')}")
        # never keep a token in the stored remote URL
        _run(["git", "remote", "set-url", "origin", f"https://github.com/{repo}.git"], cwd=path)
    sync(path, repo, token)
    return path


def sync(path: Path, repo: str | None = None, token: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Fetch branches and Entire checkpoints (refs/entire/*, or the _entire/* branch fallback)."""
    remote = _url(repo, token) if repo else "origin"
    _run(["git", "fetch", "--quiet", remote, "+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*",
          "+refs/entire/*:refs/entire/*"], cwd=path, timeout=120)
    _run(["git", "fetch", "--quiet", remote, "+refs/heads/_entire/*:refs/entire/*"], cwd=path, timeout=120)
    _run(["git", "merge", "--ff-only", "--quiet", "origin/HEAD"], cwd=path, timeout=60)
EOF

+"""Request dependencies: the platform, the signed-in user, their workspace, and agent ownership."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request
+
+from ops import security
+
+_platform: Any = None
+
+
+def set_platform(p: Any) -> None:
+    global _platform
+    _platform = p
+
+
+def platform() -> Any:
+    assert _platform is not None, "platform not started"
+    return _platform
+
+
+def _bearer(request: Request) -> str | None:
+    auth = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
+    if auth.lower().startswith("bearer "):
+        return auth[7:].strip()
+    return request.query_params.get("token")
+
+
+def current_user(request: Request) -> security.Principal:
+    token = _bearer(request) or ""
+    principal = security.verify_user_token(token)
+    if principal is None:
+        raise HTTPException(401, "sign in required")
+    if security.dev_mode():
+        platform().store.upsert_user(principal.user_id, principal.login, principal.name, None)
+    return principal
+
+
+def workspace(user: security.Principal = Depends(current_user)) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return platform().store.workspace_for(user.user_id)
+
+
+def owned_agent(agent_id: str, ws: dict[str, Any] = Depends(workspace)) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    agent = platform().store.agent(agent_id)
+    if agent is None or agent["workspace_id"] != ws["id"]:
+        raise HTTPException(404, "agent not found")
+    return agent
+
+
+def sdk_agent(request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    token = _bearer(request) or ""
+    agent = platform().store.agent_by_token(token) if token.startswith("nsa_") else None
+    if agent is None:
+        raise HTTPException(401, "invalid agent token")
+    return agent
+
+
+def require_user_for_writes(request: Request) -> None:
+    """Sandbox controls spend LLM budget: require a signed-in user (outside dev mode)."""
+    if security.dev_mode():
+        return
+    if security.verify_user_token(_bearer(request) or "") is None:
+        raise HTTPException(401, "sign in to use the sandbox controls")
